question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Confined
solution:
The correct answer is "**Limited**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• "**Confined**" means having limits or restrictions. (सीमाओं या प्रतिबंधों का होना)

 
 
• **Example**- The research was confined to a few aspects of the disease. 
 
 
 
• "**Limited**" means having a certain limit; not extensive or wide-reaching. (एक निश्चित सीमा होना; व्यापक या व्यापक नहीं होना)
 
 
• **Example**- Her knowledge of the subject is very limited.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word "Confined" is 'Limited.'

Therefore, the correct answer for ‘**Option 1**’.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• **Extravagant**: This means exceeding the limits of reason or necessity.(तर्क या आवश्यकता की सीमाओं को पार करना)
 
• **Diluted**: This refers to something that has been made weaker in force, effect, etc.(किसी ऐसी चीज़ से जिसे बल, प्रभाव, आदि में कमजोर बनाया गया है)
 
• **Halted**: This means to cause to stop.(रुकने का कारण बनना)
